title: Fashionable Waterproof Cycling Headphones With Long Battery Life
body_html:
Product information:
Overview:
This multi‑functional helmet Bluetooth headset is designed for cycling enthusiasts, combining Bluetooth connectivity, intercom communication, an FM radio, and music playback in one device. It features water‑ and dust‑resistant performance, supports voice control and battery level display, delivers clear stereo sound, and offers up to 40 hours of battery life, meeting both safety and entertainment needs during rides.

Specifications:
Chip Type: Allwinner series
Audio Channel: Stereo
Transmission Range: 10 meters
Battery Life: 40 hours
Key Features: Supports Bluetooth, waterproof, dustproof, intercom, music playback, battery level display, call functionality, and voice control
Compatible Models: Y20


Packing list:
Headphones + Charging Cable + Instruction Manual * 1
